label: Entries
description: What the monitor keeps: one record per observed call, identified by its id. The collection is where the record type is written down, so the graphs below name the store and the collection and repeat no shape. It also says what the records may not repeat and what an added column gives the rows already there, so the compiler judges a filter or a patch against the declaration rather than the database finding out at run time.

entries.description: the observed calls, one row each: no two record the same call, and a row that predates the user agent column reads as unknown

latest.description: the most recent call recorded for each method, one row per method: written in the same transaction as the entry itself, so the two cannot disagree
